effective_date: Upon full execution by all parties
payment_terms: s if sales targets are hit
purpose: I run a boutique creative agency and just got asked to help launch a fast-moving celebrity-backed beverage brand, but everything is happening through texts and rushed calls and I need a real agreement now. We’d be handling branding, social media content, influencer outreach, launch events, ad creative, website updates, and ongoing strategy, while they may also introduce investors and retail partners. I need clear terms for monthly retainer plus bonus payments if sales targets are hit, ownership of logos/videos/content we create, approval timelines, who pays outside vendors, confidentiality because public figures are involved, use of likeness/name rights, limits if they cancel suddenly, reimbursement for travel/events, exclusivity in beverage category, non-circumvention if our contacts lead to deals, dispute process, and what happens if there’s scandal or reputation damage. I also want it easy for both sides to review changes together, tighten wording, and sign digitally once finalized.
title: Consulting Agreement
